en: Improved `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, the `/permissions` auto mode environment prompts, and the `/plugin` "Add marketplace?" and "Run this command?" prompts: they now use the standard dialog frame with key hints, and Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D cancels them on the second press like other dialogs
zh: 改进 `/install-github-app`、`/desktop`、`/permissions` 的自动模式环境提示，以及 `/plugin` 的“Add marketplace?”和“Run this command?”提示：现在使用带按键提示的标准对话框框架，Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 第二次按下时取消，与其他对话框一致
